asr.full_text: Polygon was one of the worst performers in the last years, but suddenly it wakes up again. The question is why? Who's buying here? Who's selling here? What are the news that are driving this rally? Let's have a look at the data most people are not looking at. In the last month, we went up by 43%. We are currently at 17 cents while Bitcoin at the same time just went flat. This is the long-term MATIC US dollar chart. We peaked at $2.80 at the same time just went flat. This is the long term emetic US dollarr chart. We peaked at $2.80 at the end of 2021 and since then there was way more pain than gain. So, this is the linear scale once we've changed to the logarithmic scale which now gives us constant percentage changes for vertical differences. It appears as if the current rally of roughly 80% still gives some space for the upside because in the past we have seen rallies of 180%. Now, here is why I do not like using U.S. dollar charts. The problem is that crypto is highly correlated, right? When Bitcoin and Ethereum goes up, then most of the altcoins go up as well, including Polygon Matic. Now, a lot of this rally, the 180% rally was just the general market going up. What I like much more is to look at how is an asset doing relative to Bitcoin, relative to other altcoins, because then we can see how particular asset is performing, relatively speaking. Is it really outperforming, is it worth the additional risk? So when we don't use the US dollar chart. But we look at MATIC relative to the others market cap. So that's the market cap of all the altcoins that are not in the top 10... Then this current rally looks very, very different relative to the rest of the altcoin market. The peak in polygon MATIC happened at the beginning of 2023, not at the end of 2021. So, MATIC did go down since 2021 but it went down less than the rest of the altcoin market. Really, the sell-off started at the beginning of 2023. The current Rally compared to the rest of the altcoin market is actually the most we have ever seen during the last three years. Every time we got a rally we subsequently sold off but none of those rallies have been as extended compared to the current one the biggest value was probably this one over here a relative gain compared to the rest of the old corn market by 42 percent and so this is finally the turn around can Polygon Matic now outperform or are we going to see another sell off? Let's just try to figure out what's actually causing this rally here. Here is what coin market cap's A.I. is giving us the announcement of a new project, a payment infrastructure project, a token burn of 3 million pol and a technical breakout. We've already talked about the technical breakout. What about the token burn? Three million when the total supply is 10.5 billion really doesn't make any difference at all. So, clearly this is not driving the rally either. It could be the announcement of the new payment infrastructure project. Here is the news article but it's still plans. It's nothing that has already been shipped. Open money stack is intended to support stable coin-based payments but it's nothing that has already been shipped open money stack is intended to support stable coin based payments but expected to launch later this year an announcement that has been made two days ago and that's also when the rally in Polygon started now in general it's positive that Polygon is still developing new but usually sustained price growth has to come from adoption not just from plans of a future project. Close to 50 percent of price growth in the matter of just a few days. I'm not sure if that's justified. There must be another explanation as well. Here is what I think is going on. This is the Polygon price on an hourly chart and what we see here in this crash that's the 10th of October. Many altcoins crashed on that day and then very quickly recovered the automated market makers the trading bots they bought up this very cheap supply by the way if this is not your very first time watching this channel then feel free to subscribe over here i publish videos regularly and when you're subscribed youtube is more likely to recommend the videos of this channel again but a lot of longs got liquidated on that day many people they were betting on rising prices lost everything just because of this very short-term distortion what that liquidation then led to is a change in the balance of longs versus shorts we see this in polygon metic we also see this for other altcoins before the funding rate for polygon was quite constantly in the positive territory. So there were more longs than shorts. It costs money to bet on rising prices of polygon. This has now switched. Now we tend to see negative funding rates. Most of the time, there are more shorts than long, more people are betting on falling prices than on rising prices. Why is that? Because all of the lungs have already lost the entire capital and they're not coming back any time soon. The speculators that lost their money on the 10th of October, they felt defrauded. They didn't lose their money because they bet on the wrong altcoin. They lost their money because the pricing system didn't work properly. And that was mainly an issue with Binance that then rolled over to other exchanges as well So because of that the speculative capital on Polygon Matic crashed massively So the open interest, the amount of bets, went from 130 million to 73 million And again that money did not come back What I believe happened here with Polygon Matic is that since this negative trend in Matic is so constant that the average retail investor simply just added more and more short positions to that trend and made money along the way. Now, all the longs got liquidated over here. Only shorts are left. And so the market makers bought up a lot of the Polygon Matic supply. And they're now short squeezing off the people that are betting on falling prices. So first there was all the longs that got liquidated, now it's all the shorts that got liquidated. The market is going the path of maximum pain. The trading volume is also at record levels again indicating potential short-term market manipulation. it's also at record levels, again indicating potential short-term market manipulation. Yes, the news and the new project is great but it's not really worth that much price appreciation. It's just the plan. And so my plan with the Matic Token is very clear. I think that this rally at some point will stop and that we will see continued selling pressure again. So I'm simply waiting for the turnaround. Once the short squeeze ends, then I will enter a short position as well. All the longs got liquidated. Many shorts are currently getting liquidated. At some point, there will be equilibrium again. And that's the time when I will enter my short position. I will, of course, enter a relative short. So I'll bet on falling POR prices and prices at the same time, rising bitcoin prices. Then we're getting this performance over here, right? This is bitcoin relative to Matic. And when this is dipping, then bitcoin is underperforming Matic or in other words, Matic has a rally. That's also what we currently see. And I do expect there's a good chance of long term trend prevails and that bitcoin is going to outperform Matic at some point again. Will this happen directly right now? Are we going to see a bit more of a short squeeze and will we then see the recovery? It's very hard to say. In the past we have seen the turnaround pretty much at the current price levels. But I'm just waiting. This is just the Polygon Matic price. I'm waiting for the current rally to see a relatively clear turnaround maybe once we are at 16 cents or so and then I will bet on falling prices at the same time of course rising prices of Bitcoin I want to play the Delta I do not want to get caught up in the correlation of the general market if all of crypto is going up then POL of course can go up as well it might simply just go up less than the rest. If it's your first time here. Feel free to subscribe. I publish the US Weekly. Feel free to also check out the Premium Membership. This is where I share my own trades.
